formatVersion.description: Bundle inventory format. 1 (assumed when absent) records path/type/sha256/bytes only. 2 additionally records the file mode, so a consumer can tell an interpreter-invoked script from an executable one instead of inferring it from a shebang that no chmod ever backed.

mode.description: POSIX mode as published. Every script in this repository is 0644 and carries a decorative shebang: nothing chmods them, so they must be invoked through the interpreter the manifest declares. Recording the mode says that out loud rather than leaving a consumer to trust the shebang.
